correctness.rationale: Independent identical Pois(lambda), lambda>0: M=(X+Y+|X-Y|)/2. Skellam series yields k=e^{-2lambda}I_0(2lambda) and h=lambda e^{-2lambda}(I_0+I_1), E[M]=lambda+h and Var(M)=lambda+lambda*k-h^2. Derive h'=k from Bessel derivatives and Cov(S,|D|)=2lambda*k; for r=I_1/I_0, R=h^2/(lambda*k)=lambda*k*(1+r)^2 has (log R)'=(1-r)[2+1/(lambda(1+r))]>0 as 0<r<1. The small- and large-lambda Bessel asymptotics give R->0 and R->infinity, hence exactly one crossover, root 1.16679740191840365086656...; sign before/after follows from lambda*k*(1-R). E[M]-Var(M)=h^2+lambda*exp(-2lambda)*I_1>0. Independent direct finite Poisson-max probability mass summation verified exact-moment formulas at six intensities; this finite check is not the crossing proof. Asymptotic Var(M)/lambda->1-1/pi is consistent. No claim for unequal rates or more than two counts.
residual_risks: Finite high-precision direct-mass tests do not constitute uniform proof; the analytic derivative and endpoints are decisive.
